gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Tightly knit, confident rows come from Oswald. Noto Sans Kawi then carries the paragraphs, its c opening like a pair of pliers, so text runs along cleanly and without fuss.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Confident and strong, Oswald sets tightly knit rows of text. Noto Sans Manichaean brings modern, clean letters with open-mouthed e crossbars, and that crisp openness against the dense heading is the real draw.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Strong, confident Oswald keeps its rows tightly knit, while Noto Sans Mongolian flares its terminals outward in a modern, neutral voice. Give the body a little more size so those flares show.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans draws tubular, bent-copper strokes with big open eyes, a modern voice under the heading. And Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs, a fun, retro streak that gives the whole thing its charm.
gen-righteous-gf-vend-sans: Righteous looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter, loud and fun. Vend Sans keeps a ruler-drawn line and wide, unclosed terminals, so the page settles down after the flourish.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk is approachable, with big open-looking e and a shapes and terminals that never close in. Metamorphous adds a commanding, distinctive swagger for the sans to push against.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-noto-znamenny-musical-n: Oswald brings confident, strong letters set in tightly knit rows. Noto Znamenny Musical Notation, clean and modern with terminals stopping far from the stem, keeps extended reading light and unhurried.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-roboto: Grandstander is bold and expressive, with pencil-line consistency, short ascenders and letters that feel held open rather than curled shut. Roboto follows with generous, round mouths, giving the loud heading a clean partner.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Eater is dark and aggressive, with thin strokes beside moderately weighty stems, wide gaps between letters and short ascenders. Its menace lands at display size; Noto Sans Tai Tham handles the rest.
gen-righteous-gf-huninn: Righteous is all swagger, its round bowls crowding the line edge to edge with a fun, commanding streak. Righteous makes the entrance, while modern Huninn does the steady work.
